text:
Sara (Partnerships): Quick sync — cloud portal onboarding (AWS / GCP / Azure). I'm assembling the packaging bundle but hitting a few gaps: 1) publisher account IDs for each cloud, 2) canonical licensing matrix (trial vs paid entitlements across clouds), 3) final logo/legal asset QA timeline. Target: have packaging ready for first pass by EOD next Fri. Any major blockers?

Mike (Legal): Can you drop the draft EULA text you're planning to ship with the listing? Need to check export controls + data residency clauses. Also callout: trials sometimes require a separate trial T&Cs/SLA — do we treat trials as feature-limited or time-limited?

Anya (Product): For packaging I'd recommend one canonical SKU per offering and cloud-specific mapping files, to avoid duplicate entitlements in billing. Proposal: base sku: redwood-inference-base, addon: dedicated-capacity, addon: private-vpc. Trials: default 14d, opt-out per region. I'll sketch the SKU->cloud mapping today and paste it here.

Rajesh (Cloud Ops): Publisher ID notes: AWS uses Seller ID (console -> Seller profile), GCP has a Publisher ID tied to the Cloud Marketplace account, Azure requires Partner Center Publisher ID. I have test values we can use for staging: aws-test-seller-12345, gcp-pub-98765, azure-pub-45678. I can add marketplace-admin roles if you list GC/AD usernames. Also reminder: AMI/VM images need signed manifests + sha256 checksums. Example checklist snippet we use: ```
# get AMI checksum (example)
sha256sum path/to/ami-image
# publisher id in AWS console -> Settings -> Seller ID
```

DeployBot: Artifacts uploaded: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/artifacts/1766661234 - includes placeholder logos (SVG/PNG), packaging README, and a PR template for legal review.

Mike (Legal): FYI: if we reference any 3rd-party icons or partner logos (e.g., cloud vendor co-branding) we need explicit permissions. Also confirm whether telemetry/usage logs include customer identifiers — that changes the retention/export language.

Sara (Partnerships): Action items from here:
- Rajesh: share the explicit publisher IDs and grant marketplace-admin to Anya + Sara by Tue COB (owner: Rajesh).
- Anya: post SKU mapping JSON + packaging draft by Tue EOD (owner: Anya).
- Mike: review EULA draft and flag any export/data residency changes by Wed EOD (owner: Mike).
- Sara: coordinate logo approvals with Marketing and schedule a 30m sync Thu (I'll send calendar invite).

Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when they have the owners/assignees? If anything else missing (billing manifest, sample pricing tier details), call it out now so we can include in the packaging bundle. Thanks! :pray:
